source_to_record.source_anchor_editorial_summary: Continuation: Moon sign's position and house portion indicates door side
Moon fixed sign — house has one door
Moon movable sign — raised doorway, possibly a smaller additional one
Saturn aspect to that sign — door broken and repaired, old or black
Mars aspect to same sign — fire or burning at doorway
Saturn and Mars favourable aspect to same sign — iron or strong door
Moon unfortunate — broken or bruised gate
Moon faint of light — entrance in back rather than highway side
Tokens of the thief's house — new heading
Moon square, conjunction or opposition Mars — burnt or cut by iron
Moon trine or sextile Mars — mended with iron
Moon newly increasing light — partly underground gate or step downward
Moon fixed or movable — one outward door; common sign — multiple doors
Moon fixed sign Taurus/Aquarius — ground-level or bank-side door alternatives
Moon movable sign — door raised, requiring step
Moon unfortunate — gate broken; lunar quarter indicates side
Saturn applying to Moon by hard versus soft aspect — damaged versus mended gate
Of the house where the thief remaineth or dwelleth — new heading
Judge location by significator's sign and celestial quarter; clause continues printed349

source_scope_note: Original margin gives ironwork and descending steps interpretations; they are source annotations, not verified physical observations.
